Crash (1996) - One of the lesser known David Cronenberg works, one of my favorites. Not to be confused with that garbage movie of the same name from 2004

Even the cast is a weird symphonic collision. James Spader, Elias Koteas (I always call him Casey Jones), Holly Hunter, Rosanna Arquette, Deborah Unger, oh man. It's classic Cronenberg, a deep intimate study of a very obscure obsession. You should probably watch Dead Ringers (1988) while you're at it. Terrible quality trailer here, apologies in advance.

Cronenberg is an absolute genius. Such a great film, and the book is completely on par as well. A dark illusion of human dependence on technology. Another sweet film as well, Jeremy Irons performance in Dead Ringers was stunning. A truly brilliant and disturbing film. Let us celebrate with some cake and some orange pop. And some ice cream

I love how he's got different modes, almost like he can be several different directors. One of my favorites from him is Eastern Promises, it surprised me that that was a Cronenberg movie. Viggo Mortensen was SO fantastic in that. That's one of my favorite performances from him, along with Lalin from Carlito's Way and Lucifer from The Prophecy.
